name: Tremor Tower
summary:
Steady hands. Shaky ground.

A tower of loose wooden blocks stands in front of you. Tap a block to feel whether it is loose or tight, slide it out slowly, carry it up and place it on top. The tower is always real physics: a forced pull stretches a visible tension gap, the tower creaks and puffs dust where it hurts, and a shaky hand shows on the Pulse meter. Hold your breath, slow down, and build higher than anyone.

- Hands or controllers: pinch, grip, poke and push with hand tracking or with Touch controll
